newsitem.title: USA: Rich Coast names president Fagan as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rich Coast names president Fagan as CEO.

text.p: Rich Coast Inc said Tuesday it appointed president James Fagan to the additional position of chief executive officer.
Fagan succeeds Robert Truxell, who remains chairman.

Rich Coast, which provides non-hazardous industrial waste treatment services to major corporations, also said it became a Delaware corporation and completed its move from British Columbia to the United States.

The company said its goal is to expand its waste handling capacity, complete its expansive new biological remediation and treatment system and complete the facilities of a 17-acre former fuel terminal in Dearborn, Mich., for treatment and recovery of waste oil.

Rich Coast also said its new biological treatment system and waste oil processing line are expected to be completed in April, when the company anticipates the initiation of organic waste processing service to several large manufacturing companies.
